item.title: ClubCheck: Event Discovery That Fills Itself
item.description: A three-service event discovery platform where a scraper uses a tiered LLM pipeline to find, classify, and publish concerts and club nights automatically. ASP.NET Core, Node.js, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Azure Container Apps.
